admission.justification: Losing uncommitted parked or owner-written bytes, or retiring their sole restoration authority after a misleading proof, is a plausible costly error; the named transaction witnesses check the obligation before such loss can be accepted.

applicability: Cancellation of admitted sync stops with kept parked-work authority, including later/unproved state preserved by product save-first recovery.
conditions: All sides pass pinned-head/transaction-authority prechecks; operation-owned bytes may be discarded and unattributable bytes must first be durably saved; prior completed manifests are readback-verified on recovery.
Already-restored sides remain recoverable from kept stashes until terminal publication.
A retry after interrupted cancellation restores the same pre-sync pair and parked content.
exclusions: Unsaveable unattributable state refuses without destructive progress; saved owner state is not adopted as transaction output.
Malformed/missing authority retains its separate quarantine/manual-repair boundary.
Gitlink/submodule content without comparable byte ownership is not silently discarded.

evidence: Synced freeze 231622b2c7e272e7ca182ec28d3da61ca1749e0f + tracked diff d4c93e6a94ef056ca4d5eb77d4c05d73eac6062654729e2cb979d0cfd870141f (S2 documentary correction of the S list: stale symbol spellings and the rule-1 inventory rationale corrected, all other producer fields identical); ResumedConvertedMemoryMergeTests (2 tests) in test_sync_parked_candidate.py.

statement: Cancel from any stop between a head's move and the parked work's settling restores the pre-sync heads and the parked work exactly as parked — including already-restored sides, ordinary retained merges, and stash-owned uncomputable entries — and drops only its own stash.
